feeds.title: Osborne Clarke Fintech
feeds.description: Osborne Clarke Fintech is one of the most dynamic international commercial law firms in Germany and provides client work at the highest level. Explore their article feed and get up-to-date on the latest trends in Germany's Fintech and other business sectors.

feeds.title: Contextual Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Browse original and curated content about FinTech, digital banking, LegalTech, and innovation brought to you by Contextual Solutions via their blog. Contextual Solutions is a Berlin-based Consultancy, Coaching, and Publication Agency specializing in FinTech, LegalTech, and tech marketplaces.

feeds.title: FinanceFWD
feeds.description: Keep your finger on the pulse of Finance and Technology with FinanceFWD comprehensive and precise coverage. Finance Forward is the new German-language portal about New Finance. We not only report on Fintech, Blockchain and Crypto, but also let the classic financial world have its say. Critical and independent.

feeds.title: Fintech News » Fintech Germany
feeds.description: Fintech News Switzerland provides a source of timely, deep insights and the latest local and global news about Fintech. Launched in 2014, the Fintech News Network team works very hard to deliver fintech-centric content in various forms to an audience looking for updates on fintech events and webinars, stunning opinions and more.

feeds.title: FinTech Magazine
feeds.description: Check out Inside views on the FinTech business. The FinTech Weekly Magazine features insider articles on recent issues and strategies in the finance industry. The articles are authored by professionals from the financial and tech industry, providing profound insights into topics that really matter today - and tomorrow.

feeds.title: CrossLend Platform Blog
feeds.description: Read CrossLend's latest insights on FinTech, private debt, finance and innovation. Browse perspectives, industry insights, and speculation for industry veteran discussing the future trends of Finance and Innovation. CrossLend is a leading capital lender boosting Europe's lending and investment ecosystem and facilitating the flow of capital across Europe.

feeds.title: Finway Blog
feeds.description: In their blog, Finway informs you about exciting and worthwhile topics around corporate finances. Finway is a global payments solution provider that enables SMBs to shape simple and flawless finance processes by which finance departments can deliver real-time insights.

feeds.title: Payment & Banking
feeds.description: Explore a range of perspectives on industry trends, emerging technologies, regulatory changes, and their impact. Payment & Banking is an award-winning blog and podcast for the Payment, banking, and FinTech sectors with a special geographical focus on Europe (especially the D-A-CH region) but with global topics.

feeds.title: FinTech Futures » Germany
feeds.description: The What the FinTech? podcast is hosted by our editor, Paul Hindle, and reporter, Alex Pugh, with a different guest each episode.In each episode, released bi-weekly, we'll be discussing trending topics, with our guests sharing useful insights and strong opinions from their area of expertise. We'll also be ruthlessly banishing buzzwords to our 'fintech jailhouse'!The podcast is free and available on all major platforms, such as Spotify, Apple Podcasts and Soundcloud.
